note: Canonical contractor identities for by-contractor rankings. src/lib/contractors.ts first normalizes a raw contractor string (cut a trailing ' — ' scope note, strip a trailing parenthetical, fold case and diacritics to a slug) and then looks it up here. Entries are only needed where normalization alone would split or merge firms incorrectly — everything else resolves heuristically. An entry with `members` is a joint venture: a lot is credited to the JV *and* to each member. Aliases are matched against the raw string, the em-dash-cut string and the parenthetical-stripped string, in that order, so `Webuild (Astaldi)` resolves to Astaldi before the parenthetical is discarded.

contractors.name: Astaldi
contractors.note: Webuild acquired a majority stake in Astaldi in 2020; Astaldi continues as a subsidiary, so contracts awarded to Astaldi stay under Astaldi rather than folding into Webuild.

contractors.name: Webuild
contractors.note: Salini Impregilo S.p.A. was renamed Webuild in 2020 — same legal entity, so the two names are merged.
